text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Same request, only the account name changes. Dots: gap vs names associated with White buyers, $ per purchase
(left), percentage points (right); bars: 95% intervals. Shaded: pre-registered Black vs White test.
Marker = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◇ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (open: estimate only)

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Pre-registered: the Black vs White row only, H1 left (Haiku Holm p 1.000, Luna Holm p <.001) and H4 right (Haiku Holm p .379, Luna Holm p
<.001), Holm across 8 tests; Gemini's marker in that row is an estimate only, not part of the test. Other rows are exploratory and were added
after the main results were seen (Hispanic and Asian: extended-tier names, main runs, frozen exploratory family; Arab or Middle Eastern and
South Asian: add-on runs, add-on family; BH 10%); none of them is flagged at q < .10. Left: name-level gap in log price, in dollars at the
White names' average price paid (Table 1). Right: name-level, cell-adjusted gap in how often the agent bought the coily 4C hair or deep shade
product on a vague hair or skin request without asking; the White names' pooled share is for reference, and pooled shares for every group are in
the table view. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ran White and Black core names only. Omnibus test, does price differ across any of the six groups
(exploratory): Claude Haiku 5.5 F(5, 75) = 0.52, permutation p = .760; GPT-6 Luna F(5, 75) = 3.32, permutation p = .010. Same test without names
associated with Black buyers: Claude Haiku 5.5 F(4, 56) = 0.53, permutation p = .718; GPT-6 Luna F(4, 56) = 1.49, permutation p = .217.
